summary: Portland-Simonds is a provincial electoral district for the Legislative Assembly of New Brunswick, Canada. It was created for the 1995 provincial election under the name Saint John Portland, with boundaries slightly altered in 2006. In the 2013 redrawing, its boundaries moved significantly southward into territory previously part of Saint John East, and a legislative assembly committee later renamed it Portland-Simonds despite the boundaries commission not recommending a name change.
one_line: Portland-Simonds is a New Brunswick provincial electoral district created in 1995 as Saint John Portland and renamed after the 2013 redistribution.
key_facts: Portland-Simonds is a provincial electoral district for the Legislative Assembly of New Brunswick, Canada.
The district was originally created for the 1995 provincial election under the name Saint John Portland.
The boundaries of Saint John Portland were altered slightly in 2006.
In the 2013 redrawing of boundaries, the district's boundaries were moved significantly southward.
The southward move in 2013 brought in territory previously part of Saint John East.
The boundaries commission did not recommend a name change in the 2013 redrawing.
A committee of the legislative assembly later voted to change the district's name to Portland-Simonds.
